title: Steady Course
description: A shipment stepping toward its destination should get monotonically closer with every tick, never drift sideways or backtrack toward where it came from.
successCondition: Book a shipment with an origin and destination that are clearly far apart. Call POST /api/tracking/:id/advance repeatedly (at least 4 times, or until delivered), querying current_lat/current_lng from the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` after each call. Computing the straight-line distance from the current position to destination_lat/destination_lng after each tick shows it strictly decreasing call over call — the shipment is always getting closer, never farther, and never overshoots past the destination's coordinates.
hints: The simulation steps position a fraction of the remaining distance toward the destination each tick (apps/api/src/modules/tracking/service.ts) — a simple haversine or even flat lat/lng distance approximation is precise enough to confirm the monotonic trend here.
Log current_lat/current_lng after every single advance call rather than just checking the first and last, so a transient backtrack in the middle can't hide.
